openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Saturday’s gate is clear skies, a camp opener, and a weekend board — not the overnight Progressive stack. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Own the threshold from the first breath.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not wait for a clean inbox or a perfect admin stack to start. Fierce calm is Saturday composure when the week’s noise wants the first hour: charge first, body second, security skim when ready, iRacing and Progressive only after the morning has already won. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Competitors may still be refreshing TNF recaps or agent-leak filings; he arrives prepared for the weekend board. When pressure rises, he slows the breath, names the next action, and outlasts the noise. Today is not about proving anything on the scoreboard. It is about banking competitive calm so camp openers, the Sunday slate, and quiet admin have a clean operator behind them. Fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Saturday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Clear skies outside; tempo inside before the weekend board. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips if you want a second RipStick move.

Gnostic builders drew the temple plan before choosing stones. An AI stack map is the same rite: name the layer (model, retrieval, agent, tool, memory) before you pick a logo.
Esoteric athletes lit one lamp before reading the scoreboard. Opening Bell is that lamp. Camp openers and Sunday wires are the board — useful only after the room is already lit.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.body: “By wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is established; by knowledge the rooms are filled with all precious and pleasant riches.” (Proverbs 24:3–4) Solomon’s counsel for a clear Saturday is architecture before motion — build the house (charge + body + one security skim), then fill the rooms (camp board, Sunday slate, quiet admin). Classical lore cast Solomon as one who ordered the temple plan before sunrise. Order the Saturday the same way, so the weekend meets a settled operator — not a scrambling one.
grimoire.practice: Finish Opening Bell and the 3-minute opener before any security skim or iRacing/Progressive admin. Wisdom first; rooms second.

techDemo.kicker: Fast learn · from your X bookmarks
techDemo.pick: Modern AI Stack Map — ChatGPT is the window; the stack is the building
techDemo.author: @learnbyIsmail

image.alt: Newsprint diagram — Modern AI Stack Map: LLMs · Agentic · RAG/Mem · Orchestration · Apps/Ops

lesson.oneLiner: Most people think AI = ChatGPT. The real map is a dependency graph — models, agents, RAG, memory, MCP, evals — and systems fail at the handoffs, not inside one logo.
beats: Name the layer first: LLM → agentic → RAG/embeddings → memory → MCP/tools → evals/security.
A stack map is not a shopping list — it’s how pieces depend on each other.
Agents only as reliable as tools + guardrails + evaluations.
Moat = how the stack works together in production, not collecting more tools.
lesson.takeaway: Under a minute: stop buying logos — draw the handoffs, then pick the one layer that unblocks Dom’s next build.
